impl LaneDrainForTheStrip {
    fn drain_controls_for_lane(&mut self, control: &mut Consumer<Record>) {
        while matches!(
            self.control_lane_consumer_for_this_strip
                .state_of_the_ring(),
            RingState::HasRecords | RingState::Overflowed
        ) {
            let Ok(record) = control.try_pop() else {
                break;
            };
            self.apply(record);
        }
    }
}
